title: Great day trip
text:
Great trip. Nacho was very nice and helpful. We had a lot of time to explore on our own but he gave us tips about where to go to see the best views. 
My only complaint is the windows on the van should have been cleaned. Mine had a smattering of bird poop.
author: Julie_P

title: Wonderful tour of Ronda!
text: This is a wonderful way to see Ronda and two of the White Villages! Carlos was fabulous! He was attentive but not pushy! I loved that he gave our group of eight time to see the cities at our own pace. My husband was impressed at how he observed road rules! We had a great experience and highly recommend this tour!
author: Denise_S

title: Highly worthwhile tour.
text: We had a great day.  Southern Spain was beautiful. Rhonda is exceptional.  Well worth the visit.  Our guide took great care of us.  Thanks for the day.
author: P7937YJmicheller

title: Great!
text: David was a great driver and guide. The stops were very beautiful and we had ample time in each place to explore.
author: Lily_M

title: Great day trip for Independent Travelers
text:
This was a very well-organized day trip for independent travelers. Our driver, Nacho, was very gracious. We were dropped in each town to explore on our own. I especially liked that Nacho sent us all a text with the links and Google Maps for all the things to see in Ronda, which is an amazingly beautiful city!
We had some logistics to deal with because we were meeting another driver in Ronda to bring us to our next destination, not back to Seville. And Nacho made sure everything went smoothly. Totally recommend this trip. It was just as described and just what we wanted.
author: GlobalGolfGal

title: White Villages and Ronda tour from Seville
text: We had an awesome experience touring the White Villages and Ronda! I can't recommend this tour enough. Our guide was extremely knowledgeable about this history of the area all the from Seville and into the mountains. We loved hearing her stories and getting to know her on a more personal level.
author: alexcR8551WS

title: Beautiful
text: Great day trip. Our guide David was very professional and made us feel very safe. We saw so many beautiful sites. A definite must do if you have the time.
